Fidelis Elevate
®
The only XDR platform that delivers Endpoint Security, Network Security, Deception, and Active Directory protection in one a single platform.
Capabilities:
Forensic and Metadata collection from 300+ attributes
Intelligent Active Threat Detection with MITRE ATT&CK Mappings
Predictive analysis and automation tools
Know More
Fidelis Deception
®
This proactive approach to threat detection and mitigation helps turn adversaries into targets. Fidelis Deception delivers high-fidelity alerts and events from decoys, AD credentials, poisoned data, and suspicious traffic.
Capabilities:
Continuously maps cyber terrain and provides risk analysis across terrains
Monitors IoT and cloud resources as deceptive objects.
Runs without impacting operations or users, and does not increase risk to data or resources.
Know More
Fidelis Network
®
Fidelis Network® is an NDR platform that offers full and deep internal visibility across all ports and protocols, with network traffic analysis and network behaviour anomaly detection.
Capabilities:
In-built Network Data Loss Prevention ability
Patented Deep Session Inspection technology
Allows you to decrypt for deeper analysis to detect malware
Know More
Fidelis Endpoint
®
Fidelis Endpoint®, our EDR solution, speeds investigations and gives you hands-on control so you can pinpoint and eradicate threats to your organization.
Capabilities:
Comprehensive EDR protection on-premises and in the cloud
Conduct remote, hands-on investigations and automate incident responses to common attacks
Automated and manual response to further an investigation
Know More
Fidelis Active Directory Intercept™
Fidelis Active Directory Intercept™  combines AD-aware NDR platform and integrated Active Directory deception technology with foundational AD log and event monitoring to identify and respond swiftly.
Capabilities:
Integrated intelligent deception
Sensors placed strategically across your network and clouds
Real-time malicious/suspicious activity detection and response
Know More
Fidelis Halo
®
This is our Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) which catches costly misconfigurations, configuration drift, vulnerable servers, indicators of compromise, and so much more.
Capabilities:
Patented micro agented technology, Fidelis Halo®’s Heartbeat Monitoring runs near-real-time
Comprehensive File Integrity Monitoring
Built-in Log-based Intrusion Detection
Know More
